newsitem.title: EGYPT: Iran's Velayati to meet Egypt's president on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Velayati to meet Egypt's president on Tuesday.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati will meet Egypt's President Hosni Mubarak on Tuesday in the first high level meeting since Mubarak accused Iran of masterminding an assassination attempt on his life in 1995.

Foreign Minister Amr Moussa is due to meet Velayati in Cairo on Monday and he told reporters that the Iranian minister would meet Mubarak to invite him to an Islamic conference to be held in Iran in December.

Egypt has accused Iran and Sudan of continuing support for the al-Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), the largest organisation fighting to set up a strict Islamic state in Egypt. Both Sudan and Iran deny this.
Iran was also accused of being behind the attempted assassination of Mubarak during the Egyptian leader's visit to Ethiopia in 1995.
Velayati last visited Cairo in 1994 to attend a Non-Aligned Movement meeting of foreign ministers.
